rows: Every B.Arch student must complete a minimum 100-day training period to graduate. Pay varies wildly by firm and city, and several well-known studios pay nothing at all for genuinely long working days. This is the first real income data point most families never budget for.
Rs 2.4-3.6 LPA entry (roughly Rs 20,000-30,000 a month), climbing to Rs 4-6 LPA by year 3

The largest hiring pool for fresh B.Arch graduates and also the flattest early climb. Multiple salary trackers put fresher architect pay 25-30% below an equivalent fresher engineering offer, despite the extra year of study.
Rs 3-6 LPA entry, Rs 8-14 LPA mid-level with Dynamo or parametric scripting depth
The fastest-growing digital lane in Indian architecture right now, driven by global outsourcing work and India's own BIM adoption push across infrastructure and commercial projects.
Government route: step AR, UPSC-CPWD, DDA, NBCC, HUDCO, state PWD
Level 10 entry, roughly Rs 56,100 basic plus allowances under the 7th Pay Commission (broadly Rs 7-10 LPA gross)

A genuine, stable, pension-backed route that most architecture students never learn exists, precisely because so few coaching resources cover the step Architecture and Planning paper compared with core engineering step papers.

items.heading: B
items.text: B.Arch is a five-year degree, one year longer than B.Tech, but fresher architect pay runs consistently below fresher engineering pay across most salary trackers.

items.heading: Unlike Most Engineering Branches, Architecture
items.text: Unlike most engineering branches, architecture has a hard legal licensing wall: Council of Architecture registration under the Architects Act, 1972, without which you cannot legally use the title "Architect" or sign off on drawings.

items.heading: At the Same Time, India's
items.text: At the same time, India's construction spend, BIM adoption, and a severe undersupply of urban and town planners are all creating real new demand inside and around architecture, faster than most families realise.
